class.name: PhysXFlowRenderEffect
class.brief_description: The world compositor [PhysXFlowSimulation3D] installs to draw its gas, provided by the PhysX module.
class.description: One instance per world, installed by [PhysXFlowSimulation3D] when it draws volumetrically (never instanced from a scene). Scripts reach it through the static [method get_world_compositor] to inspect which renderer backend the gas draws on.

method.name: get_world_compositor
method.description: The world's compositor when a [PhysXFlowSimulation3D] installed its Flow effect into it, or [code]null[/code] when none did.
